verdict.rationale: Devin documents automation features such as schedules (cron and one-time) and playbooks managed via the Devin MCP, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. Devin Review covers code review comments, which is an adjacent feature rather than automation version control. AGENTS.md living in a repo would only be versioned through the user's own git, which is a workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
